# Drena

> Some mornings you wake up puffy and some mornings you don't. Drena is built on the idea that this is not random — and that you can find out what actually causes it, then drain it in a few minutes.

Drena: Lymphatic Drainage — Gua Sha, Face Yoga & Depuff. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797460352?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [Best Face Yoga App for iPhone: 21-Day Plan and an Honest Comparison](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/ebb-app/best-face-yoga-app-for-iphone): How Drena's 21-Day Face Yoga program works and how it compares with FaceYogi and Luvly.
- [Best Gua Sha Routine App for iPhone: A 14-Day Plan and How the Options Compare](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/ebb-app/best-gua-sha-routine-app-for-iphone): What to look for in a gua sha app, and how Drena's 14-day plan works.
- [Bloating and Face Puffiness Tracker for iPhone: Find Your Personal Triggers](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/ebb-app/bloating-and-puffiness-tracker-app): A tracker that compares your mornings after salt, alcohol or short sleep with the mornings after none.
- [How to Do Lymphatic Drainage on Your Face at Home (With an iPhone App)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/ebb-app/how-to-do-lymphatic-drainage-on-your-face-at-home): A three-minute morning face drainage routine: neck first, then jaw and cheeks toward the ear, then down to the collarbone.
- [How to Get Rid of a Puffy Face in the Morning (and Find Out Why It Happens)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/ebb-app/how-to-get-rid-of-a-puffy-face-in-the-morning): A short morning routine for puffiness, plus a way to find which evening habits cause it.
